entities.summary: Igor Anatolyevich Komarov is a Russian politician, industrialist, financier and manager. He has served as Plenipotentiary Envoy of the Russian president to the Volga Federal District since 18 September 2018. In this position, he is a member of the Security Council of Russia. Igor Komarov was a performers & entertainers from Engels (b. 1964-05-25, Engels). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
